decisions.reason: As a core-adjacent coolant-management extension with modest carrying cost and strong fit to the firm's installed base, it remains a worthwhile option to keep open.

The centrifuge strengthens the firm's established filtration and sustainability offering, so management would likely continue it while using another year of market feedback to confirm scale potential.

This scraper belt conveyor is somewhat more peripheral and faces a clearer review point after two years, but in a growing machinery market the firm would usually retain it unless evidence turns decisively weak.
Because the magnetic belt chip conveyor sits squarely in the existing conveyor portfolio and can be sold and serviced through current channels, it is an attractive complementary product to keep.

The hinged belt conveyor still has some overlap risk with other conveyor variants, yet a large engineering firm would typically keep it for now while comparing its traction against the rest of the range.
